name: happy-memes
description: Make funny, postable image memes about news, launches, trends, and everyday moments.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any moment into a meme
interface.longDescription:
Memes turns a news story, product launch, trend, or everyday situation into an image meme you can post.

It checks what actually happened when browsing is available, drafts several joke angles before drawing anything, picks a meme format whose logic fits the joke, and writes an image prompt that keeps captions short, spelled exactly, and readable at a glance. Each meme comes with suggested post copy, alt text, and a one-line note on the moment it references.

Memes avoids real people's likenesses, fabricated quotes, and jokes at the expense of victims, and keeps results suitable for a general audience. It uses built-in image generation and connects to no outside services.
defaultPrompt: Make a meme about this week's biggest tech news
Turn this into a meme: my 15-minute standup ran an hour
Give me 3 meme options about something trending today
